items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I used to know the whole family... No, no. No, no. Ory was on this side. He'd already come in. I was on the other side.

ctx.x: Did you know Kid Ory out there?
Oh, Lord. I used to know the whole family. Kid Ory was a trombone player. And he was a trombone player too when he was down in the city.
Did you hear him in the country?
